'''The Breaking''' was the name of a large tunnel on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] that connected the [[Prowler's Trail]], the [[Verdant Swamp]] and the [[Imperial Guard Academy]] [[Training Grounds|grounds]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Breaking appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
